ritual: Read this file first, then A2A.md and docs/HARDWARE.md.
Work, run the gates, commit with measurements, update this file in-file.
rules: The firmware is scripture: if it looks wrong, our reading is wrong.
Measure before patching; the compiler and the run are the judges.
Read PDFs as rendered pages with vision; OCR text is only an index.
Model the silicon, not the firmware's minimum. An unmapped register is a recorded gap.
Use absolute Windows paths with the drive colon for file tools.
Do not copy code from Prehistoricman/TMS57070: it has no licence.
Decoded firmware stays in rom/, outside git; regenerate it with the decoder.

gates.decode_pass: exit 0; every file shows size-check ok and checksums == message count
gates.run_master_pass: no STOP line; UART2 sends bytes; flash shows sector erases; LCD writes 37381 or more
gates.presets: extract the presets zip to rom/presets_mid, then python tools/ob12_sysex.py rom/presets_mid/*.mid -o rom/presets
gates.run_slave_pass: no STOP line; UART2 Master shows 11 and the version text
gates.core_compare: build/core_compare.exe rom/dsp 2000 (needs a local public emulator copy)
gates.run_system: OB12_DIRECT=3 OB12_POT_SWEEP=14 build/ob12_system.exe rom 21 16 build/final.wav, then python tools/analyse_wav.py build/final.wav 19 20.8

status.phase: Master path works; a note sounds only on voice slot 2: slots 0 and 1 lose the signal at the 11C/187 stage; right channel zero
done: SysEx format, packing and checksum decoded for all 7 firmware files
Hardware map corrected from the schematics: 2 CPUs, 5 TMS57070, ATF1500 PLD
Carved 5 distinct TMS57070 programs from the Slave table at FC2340; opcodes 99.3-100% known against a 59.4% control
Ran programs 0, 1, 4 for 48000 samples: 512/512 words visited, 0 PC discontinuities
Audio output path: 0x0C/0D/0E flag 4 writes AX1/2/3; AX3 pass-through 100% bit-exact on programs 0 and 1
Chain test: summing bus and LFO bus reach DASP4 inputs bit-exact
Master boot on vendored F2MC-16 core: 300M instructions, 9-task RTOS, splash on LCD, FE every 300 ms
Master main screen and 849 bytes to the Slave after loading presets, 29F800 model, CALLP fix
Slave boot: banner, 849-byte Master stream consumed, 18-byte version reply, DSP load stream matches carved PMEM
Whole instrument linked; 12 voices allocated 3 per DSP; 196 Hz sawtooth captured from the voice bus
DASP4 opened: circular DMEM step and half-frame phase; note tones reach the outputs
Own TMS57070 core: 5.12M steps identical to the public emulator; start-up programs run; noise and impulse gone
MOUT carries a 196 Hz sawtooth with no forced values once pots move; Master sends panel data on change
Delayed interrupt modelled; MIDI note forwarded by the Master as 94 3C 64
Two-slot audio bus: hop 2, phase 0; summing bus forms, MOUT left RMS 82349 with three notes, idle exactly 0
Notes through the Master reach the DSPs; third note sounds; direct injection shown to break running status

assessment.note: Judgement, not measurement. Revise after each milestone.
